theorem norm_sq_hsInner_infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter_le_half
    (source e D : H →L[ℂ] H) (psi : H)
    (hsource : IsHilbertSchmidt source)
    (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (heAdj : adjoint e = e)
    (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hD : ‖D‖ ≤ 1) :

source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem norm_sq_hsInner_infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter_le_half
    (source e D : H →L[ℂ] H) (psi : H)
    (hsource : IsHilbertSchmidt source)
    (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (heAdj : adjoint e = e)
    (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hD : ‖D‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖hsInner source
        (infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter e D psi)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * hsNormSq source
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hreporter :
      IsHilbertSchmidt
        (infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter e D psi) := by
    exact ((pointedFisherConnection_isHilbertSchmidt psi (D psi)).comp_right e)
      |>.comp_left (1 - e)
  have hcs := norm_hsInner_le hsource hreporter
  have hreporterBound :=
    hsNormSq_infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter_le_half
      e D psi he heAdj hpsi hD
  have hsourceSq : hsNorm source ^ 2 = hsNormSq source := by
    rw [hsNorm, Real.sq_sqrt (hsNormSq_nonneg source)]
  have hreporterSq :
      hsNorm (infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter e D psi) ^ 2 =
        hsNormSq (infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter e D psi) := by
    rw [hsNorm, Real.sq_sqrt (hsNormSq_nonneg _)]
  have hcsSq :
      ‖hsInner source
          (infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter e D psi)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        hsNorm source ^ 2 *
          hsNorm (infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter e D psi) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg
      (hsInner source
        (infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter e D psi)),
      hsNorm_nonneg source,
      hsNorm_nonneg
        (infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter e D psi)]
  rw [hsourceSq, hreporterSq] at hcsSq
  calc
    ‖hsInner source
        (infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter e D psi)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        hsNormSq source *
          hsNormSq (infiniteFisherOneCornerJoinedReporter e D psi) :=
      hcsSq
    _ ≤ hsNormSq source * (1 / 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreporterBound
        (hsNormSq_nonneg source)
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * hsNormSq source := by ring

  have hveq : ∑ i ∈ u, ‖(inner ℂ v (b i) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2

  have hv : ∑ i ∈ u, ‖(inner ℂ v (b i) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by

  have hw : ∑ i ∈ u, ‖(inner ℂ (b i) w : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖w‖ ^ 2 :=
    b.orthonormal.sum_inner_products_le w

    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by positivity
  have hB : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i ∈ u, ‖(inner ℂ (b i) w : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => by positivity
